item.title: France: Young voters blase about Glucksmann's Socialists
item.description: Raphael Glucksmann wants to lead France's Socialists to power without working with the left-populist Jean-Luc Melenchon, who is particularly popular with young voters. How can the center-left candidate win them over?
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: How reliant is Ukraine on the US-controlled Starlink internet service?
item.description: Kyiv keeps issuing warnings that the satellite internet system Starlink is being restricted in Ukraine. How dependent is the country on the system, and what would happen if it went down?
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Populist Czech PM Babis goes empty-handed in Senate elections
item.description: Opposition parties still control the Czech Senate, in a major blow to Prime Minister Andrej Babis' and his governing coalition.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Ilhan Omar: The US Democrat targeted by Donald Trump
item.description: Donald Trump has described her as "garbage" and a "criminal" who does nothing but "bitch." Congress member Ilhan Omar has long been the target of angry verbal attacks from the US president. But why her?
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: China's influence in the gaming industry is growing
item.description: Home to more than 700 million gamers, China is the world's largest gaming market — but it's also one of the most tightly regulated. The effects reach far beyond China, impacting players around the world.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
item.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: France: Protesters clash with police in nationwide protests, amid rising social polarization
item.description: Unrest broke out in parts of France as students, trade unionists and Yellow Vest activists took to the streets to protest high prices and inequality. Police arrested over 1,000 people amid chaotic scenes.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Oregon school shooting: Police praise 'heroism' of those who intervened to stop more killing
item.description: US police have praised the actions of three people who cut short a deadly shooting at a school in the state of Oregon. Three children and a teacher were killed in the attack, carried out by a former pupil at the school.
item.dc:subject: News

item.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
item.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: Hijab ban at schools in Azerbaijan: What's behind the rare wave of protests?
item.description: Girls wearing headscarves have been turned away from schools in Azerbaijan, triggering unusual protests involving children. The government rules do not mention hijabs. Why are schools enforcing unwritten rules?
item.dc:subject: World

item.title: The murder of a young mother in Iran has once again sparked debate on femicide and the social acceptance of violence against women.
item.description: The murder of a young mother has once again sparked debate in Iran over so-called honor killings, the social acceptance of violence against women and the lack of protection for people vulnerable to gender-based violence.
